correctness.rationale: For n>=4, signatures I(a_i)=A_C∪({b_i}∩C) and I(b_i)=B_C∪({a_i}∩C) give exact cases by empty, singleton and double matched columns. Counting admissible column words establishes the three full polynomials. Single-codeword deletion classifies all inclusion-minimal codes and establishes the remaining three. Actual standalone brute-force checks of 87,296 subsets for n=4..8 confirmed literal definitions, all coefficients and minimal distributions. Finite checks support but do not replace the all-n proof. Boundary n<4 is excluded.

value.rationale: The natural complete prisms have three operationally different sensing requirements; exact all-code distributions refine previously known minimum cardinalities. The n special inclusion-minimal solid codes of cardinality 2n−2 prove a large upper-minimal contrast with uniformly minimum self codes, and D_n-S_n enumerates precisely the solid-only configurations at each size. These are motivated, structurally interpretable infinite-family facts rather than routine numeric substitution.
